verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents AI-driven browser agents that run in managed cloud sessions. Users start tasks with a single API call, and the built-in Claude, OpenAI, Gemini and BrowserUse agents execute autonomously on remote infrastructure, with recordings available for later review. However, the evidence shows no way to set up recurring or triggered automations: no scheduling, cron jobs, event triggers, or callbacks. Each run appears to be launched by the user's own code. missing for 10: built-in scheduling/recurring runs, event triggers or webhooks for completion, a background job management/monitoring surface, independent hands-on corroboration of unattended runs.
